markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (55%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Two-class set, flagged input and model disagreement limit this call [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 55%, Benign 41%, Invasive 3% | Close call |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90%) | Cannot separate two classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.61 / 76th percentile, flagged | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2 Normal, 2 Benign, 1 InSitu [F5] | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 2, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · Lobule pattern scored above typical [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Stromal infiltration scored above typical [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↓ invasive · Gland formation scored high; caption check failed · Weak
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Marked pleomorphism scored high · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Unreliable here: normal lobules, mitoses, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Image-level 3% invasive risk dilutes focal carcinoma; regions 0, 1, 4, 5, 8, 9 each score high individually.
- Input is flagged (reliability 0.61), so either class call may shift on recut.

## Check on the slide
1. **8, 9**: Look for tumor infiltrating stroma; this validated concept associates with invasion.
2. **1, 5, 9**: Confirm marked nuclear pleomorphism, which also leans invasive.
3. **2, 6, 11**: Judge whether lobules are normal or benign; the lobule concept failed its spot check.
